title: Pentagon says only three UAP videos exist, then another branch admits more

tellings.quote: after some of these videos were released uh the Pentagon said yeah there's no more videos just those three videos

plain: After some military videos of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, were released, the Pentagon said there were no more videos beyond those three, and then another branch of the military admitted it had more. The journalist Michael Shellenberger tells this, crediting John Greenewald Jr., a researcher who collects government records. If true, it would mean the Pentagon's answer did not cover everything the military held.
